THE_QUESTION: Did the shared K=2 policy learn complementary latent strategies that generalize beyond the heavily replayed 428-state FIT bank?
WHY_THIS_MATTERS_MORE_THAN_USUAL: The rehearsal bank was replayed 188.86 times during training. A strong held-out crossover argues the treatment learned something beyond memorising that fixed bank. A failure says even correctly gated rehearsal did not transfer.

MODEL_UNDER_TEST.periodic_checkpoints_ineligible: all 10, hashes recorded in the freeze record

CELLS.why_the_overlay_matters_here_too: Pole A is not plain OP6. Evaluating z0 against vanilla OP6 would score it against a different opponent than it trained on.

PRIMARY_GATE_CROSSOVER.metric: episode win indicator (blue_score > red_score), per evaluation seed
PRIMARY_GATE_CROSSOVER.statistic: paired percentile bootstrap over seed-level episode outcomes
PRIMARY_GATE_CROSSOVER.provenance: This is the EXISTING frozen convention from eval_exp2_k2_terminal.py, adopted unchanged so the criterion cannot be accused of having been chosen for this result. Point estimates alone do not pass the gate.

SECONDARY_REPORTED_NOT_GATED.status: REPORTED FOR CONTEXT ONLY. No retention bar was authorized for this experiment, so it does not gate the verdict and must not be introduced as a gate after the numbers are seen.
SECONDARY_REPORTED_NOT_GATED.per_cell_win_rates: all six cells reported with seed-level CIs

EPISODES_PER_CELL.note: one deterministic episode per (cell, seed); 32 seeds gives 32 paired observations per cell

PROHIBITED_AFTER_SEEING_EVAL: changing the metric, statistic, alpha, or criterion
adding seeds to the EVAL block
promoting retention or any secondary quantity into a gate
reporting point estimates as if they passed the frozen criterion
IF_NEGATIVE: Recorded as ORACLE_GATED_K2_CROSSOVER_NOT_CONFIRMED. A treatment verified end to end that still fails to transfer is a scientific finding about oracle-gated rehearsal, not a defect to repair. The 188.86x replay factor and the 1M-vs-2M budget difference against EXP2C are both already on record as interpretive context, frozen before the result existed.
ONE_SHOT: EVAL is opened once. This spec is frozen before it is read.
